name: The Shamed Lieutenant
label: Quest
description: The Shamed Lieutenant: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank you again for delivering the statuette safely, friend.
I could use your help with something else. There's a member of the city guard who was reassigned to duty in Southshore out in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
His father was a friend of mine, and while I don't disagree that he could use the lesson... I'd still like to see him succeed. He would really benefit from someone like you helping him out.
There is a boat that can take you that way from Menethil Harbor, if you are passing back through.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
